description: This is a PHP source file defining an event listener class 'EmailConfigurationListener' within the 'OrangeHRM' HRM system. The class handles encryption and decryption of SMTP password fields in the 'EmailConfiguration' entity during lifecycle events such as pre-persist, pre-update, post-update, and post-load.

classes.name: EmailConfigurationListener
classes.description: Entity lifecycle event listener for handling encryption and decryption of SMTP passwords in email configuration entities.

methods.name: prePersist
methods.description: Encrypts the SMTP password before the entity is persisted if encryption is enabled.

methods.name: preUpdate
methods.description: Encrypts the SMTP password before the entity is updated if encryption is enabled and the password has changed.

methods.name: postUpdate
methods.description: Decrypts the SMTP password after the entity is updated if encryption is enabled.

methods.name: postLoad
methods.description: Decrypts the SMTP password after the entity is loaded from the database if encryption is enabled.
